title: Education management in the context of China's "one belt, one road" initiative: cultural "soft power" and the elimination of local differences using music computer technologies and distance learning
reason: Single-group pre/post intervention (n = 16 music students) comparing vowel acoustics, knowledge and self-assessment with paired t-tests. No LMS-recorded indicator or activity-product indicator is related to learning-action success or a personality construct.

extraction.country: China (Guizhou Province; authors at Herzen State Pedagogical University, Russia)

extraction.population: undergraduate music-performance students, local universities in Guizhou
